package.description: Remote development environments on your infrastructure provisioned with Terraform

en-US.description: Remote development environments on your infrastructure provisioned with Terraform
en-US.longDescription: Coder is an open source platform for creating and managing developer workspaces on your preferred clouds and servers. By building on top of common development interfaces (SSH) and infrastructure tools (Terraform), Coder aims to make the process of provisioning and accessing remote workspaces approachable for organizations of various sizes and stages of cloud-native maturity.
en-US.name: Coder
